title: Test Plan Output
description: Structured test plan from the test-planner agent. Consumed by test-writer for TDD code generation.

test_cases.description: Ordered list of test cases to implement

id.description: Unique identifier for this test case (e.g. TC-001)

name.description: Short descriptive name for the test case

description.description: Detailed description of what the test validates

technique.description: Testing technique used to derive this test case

inputs.description: Input values or generators for this test case

items.description: A single input value or description of an input generator

expected_outcome.description: Expected result or behavior when the test executes

coverage_targets.description: Minimum coverage thresholds the test suite should achieve
